div.head: Index
div.p: Editor’s Note: The references in this index are to document numbers. Each document is numbered within each compilation with particular prefixes. These prefixes are as follows: ETA: U.S. regional economic and technical assistance policy; BL: Bolivia; CI: Chile; CO: Colombia; CR: Costa Rica; DR: Dominican Republic; EC: Ecuador; ES: El Salvador; GT: Guatemala; HA: Haiti; HO: Honduras; NI: Nicaragua; PM: Panama; PA: Paraguay; PE: Peru; UR: Uruguay; and VE: Venezuela.
